edges.reason: msg.sender is the sender whose balance transfer() debits.
burn() burns from msg.sender.
receive() refunds msg.value to msg.sender.
msg.sender is mixed into the keccak256 randomness seed in randNumber.
msg.sender must equal newOwner in acceptOwnership.
block.timestamp drives the firstBlock deadline and the anti-bot window in transfer.
block.timestamp is compared against firstBlock to enforce the max buy.
block.timestamp (with block.difficulty) seeds the burn randomness.
Timestamp gate conditionally requires _amount <= 5 during the first 15 minutes.
transfer() calls randNumber() to size the burn.
Predictable block values produce the modulo-9 weak randomness.
mul/div/sub over _amount and _rand determine the burnt and transferred amounts.
The computed _amountToBurn is passed into _burn.
transfer() burns a randomized portion of the amount.
transfer() calls super._transfer for the unburnt tokens.
burn() calls super._burn(msg.sender, _amount).
transferFrom() calls super._transferFrom.
_transferFrom performs the balance movement via _transfer.
_transferFrom decrements the allowance via _approve.
approve() delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance() delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance() delegates to _approve.
receive() executes msg.sender.transfer(_amount) before any state is settled.
The external value transfer to msg.sender can call back into receive()/transfer() of this contract.
transfer() updates _balances through _transfer and _burn.
transfer() writes firstBlock = block.timestamp + 15 minutes on the first transfer.
transfer() flips the firstTransfer flag.
transfer() accumulates totalBurnt with the burnt portion.
burn() accumulates totalBurnt with _amount.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by value.
_burn requires _totalSupply - value > MinSupply before reducing supply.
MinSupply caps how much _burn can remove from the supply.
Constructor mints 1000 ether into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits _balances[msg.sender] with the minted amount.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner in transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership gates execution on msg.sender == newOwner.
transferOwnership writes the staged _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
